description: Optional envelope read by `pgschema --request <path>` instead of flags. Flags given on the command line override envelope args.

args.description: Command arguments, named like the flags without the leading dashes.

order.description: ORDER BY columns for sample, e.g. "id DESC".

out.description: Directory to also write the JSON output to.

protocol.description: Envelope protocol version. Any other value is a usage error.

title: pgschema adapter request envelope
